easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play Rupture Spire.
When Rupture Spire enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Rupture Spire.
Resolve the Rupture Spire trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it
Haru triggers, returning Rupture Spire from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
